hero.title: When the ground shakes, know what to do.
hero.intro: Yanig shows recent earthquakes near the Philippines and around the world. It also gives safety steps and emergency numbers.

quakes.title: Recent earthquakes
quakes.error: Yanig cannot get earthquake data now. Check your internet connection.
quakes.updates: Yanig checks for new data every 10 minutes.
quakes.link: See all earthquakes on the tracker
quakes.offline: You are offline. Yanig shows earthquakes when you are online again.

during.title: During the shaking
during.intro: Do these three steps when the ground shakes.
during.stripLabel: Drop, Cover, Hold on. Use the arrow keys to change the step.

drop.name: Drop
drop.text: Drop to your hands and knees immediately.

cover.name: Cover
cover.text: Take cover under a strong desk or table. If there is no table, cover your head and neck with your arms.

hold.name: Hold on
hold.text: Hold on to your shelter. Stay in this position until the shaking stops.

finder.title: Find your city
finder.text: Yanig lists hotlines, hospitals and evacuation centres for {{cities}} cities in {{regions}} regions.

offline.title: Install it. Use it without internet.
offline.install: Add Yanig to your home screen. It opens like an app.
offline.before: Pages you opened before work without internet.

source.q: Where does the data come from?
source.a: From USGS, GeoNet (New Zealand) and BMKG (Indonesia). Yanig checks for new data every 10 minutes.

warn.q: Does it warn me before an earthquake?
warn.a: No. No one can predict earthquakes. Yanig shows earthquakes after they happen.

offline.a: Partly. Pages you opened before work without internet. New earthquake data needs internet.

free.a: Yes. Yanig is free. You do not need an account.
